case_classification.short_description: 3-SM for a company producing noodles - including deferred taxes

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally complex monthly 3-statement operational and valuation model spanning 12 years. The task requires building detailed operational schedules for 8 product types with cyclical sales, computing machine capacity limits (triggering discrete CAPEX and staffing additions), implementing complex raw material pricing structures, and setting up an annuity loan with a 5-year compounding grace period. Additionally, the modeler must account for book-vs-tax depreciation differences to model deferred taxes (DTA/DTL), calculate monthly CCC adjustments (DIO/WIP/DPO) using a non-standard forward-looking methodology, and resolve circular references from cash interest. An expert would need approximately 6 hours of highly focused work to build, audit, and balance this comprehensive model.
